## Service: files (Files API)

Documentation for the Files API

### Get File
GET /files/d/{slug}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/files/d/{slug}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/files/get-file-by-slug | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/files/get-file-by-slug.md

Get the file by slug.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: files.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- slug* string (e.g. "4JpFVX1F57j8") - Share-link slug identifying the file.

Response 200 (Returns a short-lived download URL and the file's metadata.) application/json:
- url* string - Short-lived, signed URL to download the file.
- asset_id* string - Identifier of the file.
- content_type* string - MIME type of the file.
- filename* string - Original filename.
- size* integer (format: int64) - File size in bytes.
- allow_download* boolean - Whether the file may be downloaded.

Errors: 401, 403, 404, 410
Response 401 (Missing or invalid access token.) application/json:
- error string - Human-readable error message.
Response 403 (The token is not authorized to access this file.) application/json:
- error string - Human-readable error message.
Response 404 (No file exists for this link.) application/json:
- error string - Human-readable error message.
Response 410 (This link has expired or is no longer available.) application/json:
- error string - Human-readable error message.
